title: MatchWise | Unified Monitoring
description: Unified monitoring for Oracle Cloud infrastructure, Render backend availability, Vercel frontend availability, Pino HTTP application logs, and Render log collector health. Render and Vercel host CPU/RAM metrics are not collected. Probe freshness and sample counts, optional health-check exclusion, endpoint summary, HTTP log freshness, deployment annotations and log drilldowns.

panels.title: MatchWise / Operations Center
panels.description: High-level view of all currently collected monitoring data.

options.content:
### MATCHWISE / OPERATIONS CENTER
Oracle Cloud host metrics · Backend HTTP probes every 30 minutes · Frontend HTTP probes every minute · Render API log collection approximately every minute

Probe cards show the latest observation within their freshness window. Read the probe age and sample count alongside availability. Pino timings measure application processing. Empty log results display as **No matching logs**. Query failures appear as panel errors.

panels.title: Application endpoints and deployment context
panels.description: Endpoints from the monitoring configuration. Deployment and auth metadata are operator-maintained, with no automatic verification.

panels.title: Oracle · Node Exporter
panels.description: Last Prometheus scrape of Oracle VM host metrics.

panels.title: Backend · Latest observed HTTP result
panels.description: Last observed result of the 30-minute Blackbox HTTP probe; 40-minute freshness window. See probe age and actual sample counts below. Exporter scrape failures are shown in the availability section.

panels.title: Frontend · Latest observed HTTP result
panels.description: Last observed result of the 1-minute Blackbox HTTP probe; 5-minute freshness window. See probe age and actual sample counts below. Exporter scrape failures are shown in the availability section.

panels.title: Log collector · Time since last success
panels.description: Elapsed time since a successful Render Logs API collection. The alert threshold is 300 seconds.

panels.title: Oracle · CPU utilization
panels.description: Oracle VM CPU utilization from Node Exporter.

panels.title: Oracle · Memory utilization
panels.description: Oracle VM memory utilization from Node Exporter.

panels.title: Oracle · Root disk utilization
panels.description: Root filesystem utilization on the Oracle VM.

panels.title: Backend · HTTP 5xx errors (selected period)
panels.description: HTTP 5xx responses found in Pino application logs within the selected dashboard time range. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: Backend · Age of last probe
panels.description: Age of the latest stored probe sample, found through a 40-minute window. Subquery resolution is one minute.

panels.title: Frontend · Age of last probe
panels.description: Age of the latest stored frontend probe sample within five minutes.

panels.title: Loki · Newest HTTP event (last hour)
panels.description: Most recent original HTTP event timestamp available in Loki within the last hour. No matching logs can mean no traffic or an ingestion issue. Independent of dashboard filters. This is event freshness, not measured ingestion delay.

targets.expr: 1000 * max(max_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | label_format event_epoch="{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}" | unwrap event_epoch | __error__="" [1h]) by (job))

panels.title: Oracle · Uptime
panels.description: Seconds since the Oracle VM last booted.

panels.title: Oracle · Available memory
panels.description: Available system memory, excluding reclaimable/cached memory that is in use.

panels.title: Oracle · Available disk space
panels.description: Available storage on the Oracle VM root filesystem.

panels.title: Oracle · 1-minute load average
panels.description: One-minute system load average.

panels.title: CPU utilization (%)
panels.description: Five-minute moving average of Oracle CPU utilization.

panels.title: Memory utilization (%)
panels.description: Available-based memory utilization, percent of installed RAM.

panels.title: Root filesystem utilization (%)
panels.description: Root filesystem used space percentage.

panels.title: Disk I/O · Read and write throughput
panels.description: Read and write throughput of block devices. Diskstats are recorded by Node Exporter.

panels.title: Network · Receive and transmit traffic
panels.description: Receive/transmit throughput from non-loopback network interfaces (Docker and veth devices excluded).

panels.title: System load · 1m / 5m / 15m
panels.description: Linux 1-, 5- and 15-minute system load averages; a load average is not CPU usage percent.

panels.title: 03 · RENDER | Backend availability and cold starts
Backend · Latest HTTP status code
panels.description: HTTP status code of the most recent Render backend probe (every 30 minutes).

panels.title: Backend · Latest HTTP response time
panels.description: Blackbox total HTTP probe time, including potential Render Free cold starts and network latency. Display thresholds are 2s and 10s. They are dashboard indicators.

panels.title: Backend · Successful HTTP probes (%)
panels.description: Percentage of successful stored probe samples in the selected range, per URL. Read with the sample-count card. A range with no probe samples has no percentage.

panels.title: Backend · Last probe time
panels.description: Timestamp of the latest stored backend probe sample.

panels.title: Backend · Actual probe samples
panels.description: Counts actual stored probe samples in the selected range, per URL. Display points in a range graph may repeat these samples.

panels.title: Backend · Latest exporter scrape
panels.description: A value of 1 means Prometheus could scrape the probe exporter. HTTP probe success is shown separately.

panels.title: Render · HTTP response time (30-minute probes)
panels.description: Range evaluation can repeat the latest stored sample at multiple display points. Sampling interval is 30 minutes. Use Actual probe samples for the number of independent measurements.

panels.title: Render · HTTP probe results (0/1)
panels.description: Range evaluation can repeat the latest stored sample at multiple display points. Sampling interval is 30 minutes. Use Actual probe samples for the number of independent measurements.

panels.title: 04 · VERCEL | Frontend availability (no host CPU/RAM metrics)
Frontend · Latest HTTP status code
panels.description: HTTP status code of the most recent Vercel frontend probe.

panels.title: Frontend · Latest HTTP response time
panels.description: Duration of the most recent Vercel HTTP probe.

panels.title: Frontend · Successful HTTP probes (%)
panels.description: Percentage of successful stored probe samples in the selected range, per URL. Read with the sample-count card. A range with no probe samples has no percentage.

panels.title: Frontend · Last probe time
panels.description: Timestamp of the latest stored frontend probe sample.

panels.title: Frontend · Actual probe samples
panels.description: Counts actual stored frontend probe samples in the selected range, per URL.

panels.title: Frontend · Latest exporter scrape
panels.description: A value of 1 means Prometheus could scrape the probe exporter.

panels.title: Frontend · HTTP response time history
panels.description: Frontend HTTP probe duration as observed from the Oracle VM.

panels.title: Frontend · HTTP probe results (0/1)
panels.description: Success of each sampled frontend HTTP check.

panels.title: 05 · BACKEND APPLICATION | Pino HTTP logs / Loki
HTTP requests · Selected period
panels.description: Count of Pino HTTP request logs during the selected period. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range]))

panels.title: HTTP 4xx errors · Selected period
panels.description: Client error responses (HTTP 4xx) during the selected period. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 400 | statusCode < 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: HTTP 5xx errors · Selected period
panels.description: Server error responses (HTTP 5xx) during the selected period. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: HTTP error rate · 4xx + 5xx
panels.description: Share of Pino HTTP requests with a 4xx or 5xx response. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 400 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0)) / (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Backend · HTTP 401
panels.description: Matching HTTP 401 responses in the selected period. May be an expected authentication rejection. Click to inspect.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode = 401 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: Backend · HTTP 404
panels.description: Matching HTTP 404 responses in the selected period. Click to inspect.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode = 404 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: Backend · Health requests
panels.description: Health request count in the selected range, independent of Traffic and Route contains filters.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route=~"(/api/health|/health)" [$__range]))

panels.title: Backend · Timing samples in last 15m
panels.description: Number of matching logs with nonnegative numeric responseTimeMs in the P50/P95 rolling window.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | duration_ms >= 0 | __error__="" [15m]))

panels.title: Backend · Requests per minute
panels.description: Requests per minute, calculated from a five-minute rolling window. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) * 60

panels.title: Backend · 4xx / 5xx errors per minute
panels.description: 4xx and 5xx HTTP errors per minute (five-minute rolling window). Zero is shown when there are no matching errors.

targets.expr: (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 400 | statusCode < 500 | __error__="" [5m])) or (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) * 0)) * 60

(sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 500 | __error__="" [5m])) or (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) * 0)) * 60

panels.title: Backend · P50 / P95 application response time
panels.description: Pino processing-time percentiles over a rolling 15-minute window, filtered by Traffic and Route contains. Read the timing sample count alongside these values. Very small samples produce unstable percentiles.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [15m]) by (job)

quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [15m]) by (job)

panels.title: Backend · HTTP status codes (5-minute window)
panels.description: HTTP response code counts per five-minute rolling window.

targets.expr: sum by (statusCode) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" [5m]))

panels.title: Backend · Most requested API routes
panels.description: Top 10 application routes in the selected period. Route names are also shown in the legend. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (route) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | route != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Backend · Endpoint summary
panels.description: Selected range, grouped by the exact method and route values recorded by Pino. Traffic and Route contains filters apply. Requests, 4xx, 5xx and numeric timing samples are counts. P95 is in milliseconds. Missing timing stays empty. Click a Route to inspect its logs.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])), "measure", "Requests", "method", ".*")

label_replace((sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 400 | statusCode < 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0)), "measure", "4xx", "method", ".*")

label_replace((sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0)), "measure", "5xx", "method", ".*")

label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by (method, route), "measure", "P95 (ms)", "method", ".*")

label_replace(sum by (method, route) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | duration_ms >= 0 | __error__="" [$__range])), "measure", "Timing samples", "method", ".*")

panels.title: Successful logins · 200
panels.description: Login completed successfully and returned a token. Counts POST /api/auth/login (logged as /auth/login or /api/auth/login) during the selected dashboard time range. These six auth counters use the whole HTTP log stream and are independent of Traffic, Route contains, Log status and Request ID controls. Zero means HTTP events were observed in the interval but no matching outcome was found. No matching logs means the HTTP baseline is absent. Query failures remain visible as panel errors.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", method="method", route="route", statusCode="statusCode" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | method="POST" | route=~"(/api)?/auth/login" | statusCode = 200 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", method="method", route="route", statusCode="statusCode" | event="http_request" | __error__="" [$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: 06 · LOG COLLECTOR | Collection and ingestion health
Log collector · Time since last success
panels.description: Elapsed time since a successful Render Logs API collection. The alert threshold is 300 seconds.

panels.title: Collector · HTTP events in selected range
panels.description: Unfiltered HTTP events in Loki for the selected range. Compare with filtered request totals to distinguish filter effects from lack of data.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" [$__range]))

options.content:
A successful collector run confirms that the Render API collection completed. Compare it with the newest HTTP event and the unfiltered event count. A quiet application can have old event timestamps. Request totals with **No matching logs** can also reflect the Traffic or Route contains filters.

Log counters return zero errors only when matching HTTP traffic exists in that interval. Percentiles use a rolling 15-minute window. Query failures remain visible as panel errors.

panels.title: Collector · Seconds since last successful run
panels.description: Age of the last successful Render Logs API collection. It normally resets after each successful systemd run.

panels.title: Node Exporter textfile collector · Scrape errors
panels.description: 0 = Node Exporter textfile metrics parsed successfully; 1 = parsing error.
